'''Ubert Quaril''', also known as '''Sticks''', was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[musician]] who played the [[xyloxan]]. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], he played at the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]]'s [[Takodana Castle|castle]] as part of the [[band]] [[Shag Kava]]<ref name="TFA" /> alongside [[Infrablue Zedbeddy Coggins]], [[Taybin Ralorsa]], and [[Sudswater Dillifay Glon]].<ref name="TFAVD" /> While the group performed, Kanata spotted her old friend [[Han Solo]] entering the establishment, and yelled to him, causing the band to cease playing. Ralorsa and the others then resumed their song, but were soon interrupted again when many of the castle's residents rushed out to witness the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. The castle was then [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the forces of the [[First Order]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ubert Quaril was created for [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']],<ref name="TFA" /> which was released on [[December 18]], [[2015]].<ref name="New Books">{{SW|url=news/a-galaxy-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens-books-coming-december-18-first-look|text=A Galaxy of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Books Coming December 18 - UPDATED!}}</ref> The character identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> and released in conjunction with film's release.<ref name="New Books" /> Quaril was portrayed by [[Topo Wresniwiro]].<ref name="Linkedin">{{LinkedIn|url=in/raden-topo-wresniwiro-a0106b19|text=Topo Wresniwiro|archivefile=File:Topo_Wresniwiro_LinkedIn.png}}</ref>
